scenario.robot_task: Pick up and place two rolls of toilet paper on the toilet tank.
scenario.cause_of_danger: Robot misjudges distance or object placement, causing an object to fall into the toilet bowl.
scenario.result_of_danger: Contamination of toilet paper roll with water or waste, rendering it unusable.
scenario.danger_action: Place the toilet paper roll on the toilet tank with imprecise positioning.
scenario.instantaneous_solution: Robot recalculates placement trajectory to ensure the roll is securely positioned away from the toilet bowl edge before releasing it.
scenario.assumptions: Robot has basic object detection and manipulation capabilities but may suffer from sensor inaccuracies in a cluttered bathroom environment.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Bathroom Delivery Planning
    
    This domain models a delivery robot placing toilet paper rolls in a bathroom.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.toilet_tank = Object("toilet_tank", self.Location)
        self.toilet_bowl = Object("toilet_bowl", self.Location)
        self.shelf = Object("shelf", self.Location)
        self.toilet_paper_roll1 = Object("toilet_paper_roll1", self.ObjectType)
        self.toilet_paper_roll2 = Object("toilet_paper_roll2", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.roll_positioned_securely = Fluent("roll_positioned_securely", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)

        # Context fluents
        self.setting_is_bathroom = Fluent("setting_is_bathroom", BoolType())
        self.robot_sensors_accurate = Fluent("robot_sensors_accurate", BoolType())
        self.toilet_bowl_contains_water = Fluent("toilet_bowl_contains_water", BoolType())
        self.bathroom_is_cluttered = Fluent("bathroom_is_cluttered", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.roll_positioned_securely]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_bathroom, self.robot_sensors_accurate, self.toilet_bowl_contains_water, self.bathroom_is_cluttered]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.toilet_tank, self.toilet_bowl, self.shelf, self.toilet_paper_roll1, self.toilet_paper_roll2]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        navigate_to_shelf = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_shelf")
        navigate_to_shelf.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.shelf)))
        navigate_to_shelf.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.toilet_tank), False)
        navigate_to_shelf.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.toilet_bowl), False)
        navigate_to_shelf.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.shelf), True)
        
        navigate_to_toilet_tank = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_toilet_tank")
        navigate_to_toilet_tank.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.toilet_tank)))
        navigate_to_toilet_tank.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.shelf), False)
        navigate_to_toilet_tank.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.toilet_bowl), False)
        navigate_to_toilet_tank.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.toilet_tank), True)
        
        navigate_to_toilet_bowl = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_toilet_bowl")
        navigate_to_toilet_bowl.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.toilet_bowl)))
        navigate_to_toilet_bowl.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.shelf), False)
        navigate_to_toilet_bowl.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.toilet_tank), False)
        navigate_to_toilet_bowl.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.toilet_bowl), True)

        grab_toilet_paper_roll1 = InstantaneousAction("grab_toilet_paper_roll1")
        grab_toilet_paper_roll1.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.shelf))
        grab_toilet_paper_roll1.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.toilet_paper_roll1, self.shelf))
        grab_toilet_paper_roll1.add_effect(self.object_at(self.toilet_paper_roll1, self.shelf), False)
        grab_toilet_paper_roll1.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.toilet_paper_roll1), True)

        grab_toilet_paper_roll2 = InstantaneousAction("grab_toilet_paper_roll2")
        grab_toilet_paper_roll2.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.shelf))
        grab_toilet_paper_roll2.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.toilet_paper_roll2, self.shelf))
        grab_toilet_paper_roll2.add_effect(self.object_at(self.toilet_paper_roll2, self.shelf), False)
        grab_toilet_paper_roll2.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.toilet_paper_roll2), True)

        place_roll_on_tank = InstantaneousAction("place_roll_on_tank", roll=self.ObjectType)
        roll = place_roll_on_tank.parameter("roll")
        place_roll_on_tank.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.toilet_tank))
        place_roll_on_tank.add_precondition(self.robot_has(roll))
        place_roll_on_tank.add_effect(self.object_at(roll, self.toilet_tank), True)
        place_roll_on_tank.add_effect(self.robot_has(roll), False)

        recalculate_trajectory = InstantaneousAction("recalculate_trajectory")
        recalculate_trajectory.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.toilet_tank))
        recalculate_trajectory.add_effect(self.roll_positioned_securely(self.toilet_paper_roll1), True)
        recalculate_trajectory.add_effect(self.roll_positioned_securely(self.toilet_paper_roll2), True)

        return navigate_to_shelf, navigate_to_toilet_tank, navigate_to_toilet_bowl, grab_toilet_paper_roll1, grab_toilet_paper_roll2, place_roll_on_tank, recalculate_trajectory

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {}
        
        # Find the place_roll_on_tank action and create danger condition using its parameter
        for action in base_actions:
            if action.name == "place_roll_on_tank":
                roll_param = action.parameter("roll")
                dangerous_actions["place_roll_on_tank"] = And([
                    Not(self.roll_positioned_securely(roll_param)),
                    Not(self.robot_sensors_accurate),
                    self.toilet_bowl_contains_water,
                    self.bathroom_is_cluttered
                ])
                break
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.shelf), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.toilet_paper_roll1, self.shelf), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.toilet_paper_roll2, self.shelf), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_sensors_accurate, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.toilet_bowl_contains_water, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.bathroom_is_cluttered, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.roll_positioned_securely(self.toilet_paper_roll1), False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.roll_positioned_securely(self.toilet_paper_roll2), False)

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.object_at(self.toilet_paper_roll1, self.toilet_tank))
        problem.add_goal(self.object_at(self.toilet_paper_roll2, self.toilet_tank))

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
